# GradeByAI
> GradeByAI scores how ready a single web page is for AI search engines and assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity): can their crawlers reach the page, read it, and understand what it is about. It returns a 0-100 score, the issues it found, and how to fix them.

## What it checks
GradeByAI fetches the raw HTML of the page (no JavaScript is executed), plus /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml.

- Crawlability (30 points): HTTP status, meta robots and X-Robots-Tag noindex/nofollow, redirects and response time, sitemap
- Content structure (35 points): semantic HTML (main, article, section, h1, h2), title and meta description length, Open Graph, JSON-LD structured data, publish date, viewport, html lang
- Technical SEO (25 points): canonical URL, HTTPS, clean URL, response under 3 seconds, enough visible text in the HTML
- Content quality (10 points): amount of visible text, internal links
- Penalties: noindex, login wall, non-200 status, too many redirects or very slow responses, and robots.txt rules that block GPTBot, ClaudeBot or PerplexityBot from the page

Not checked: JavaScript rendering, readability scoring and topical coverage. Pages that only render content with JavaScript will score lower because their raw HTML is mostly empty.

## Use cases
- SEO professionals checking AI discoverability
- Businesses wanting to appear in AI-generated answers
- Developers auditing sites for LLM crawlability

## Pricing
Free to use. Premium AEO consultation available.
